storeReview.whatDescription: A focused review of the parts of your store that shape the buying experience.
storeReview.deliverTitle: A review you can actually use
storeReview.deliverDescription: We prioritize the clearest opportunities rather than burying you in automated scores.

request.title: Tell us about your store
request.description: Share your store URL and the challenge you'd most like to solve.

review.title: We review it personally
review.description: A CartShift specialist inspects public customer journeys and validates findings.

next.title: Get useful next steps
next.description: We follow up with prioritized observations and an optional way to work together.

storeReview.finePrint: A focused initial review is free. It isn't a security, legal, accessibility-compliance, or exhaustive full-site audit. Additional access or deeper work will be agreed separately.

one.a: Yes. The initial expert-led review and prioritised findings are free and come with no obligation to hire us.

two.q: Do I need to give you Shopify access?
two.a: No. We start with public pages only. If deeper investigation would help, we'll explain what's needed and ask permission first.

three.a: We'll follow up by email after assessing your request. Timing depends on our review capacity; we won't claim a report was sent until it actually has been.

four.q: Do you only work with Shopify?
four.a: Shopify is our specialty, but we can assess other e-commerce platforms when the scope fits our expertise.

scopeComparison.title: Which review is right for you?
scopeComparison.intro: The free review is an initial look at your public buying journey. Paid engagements are separately scoped deep dives—not the same review with a price tag.

free.title: Free expert review
free.description: A focused first pass over public store pages with 3–5 prioritized observations and suggested next steps. No admin access required.

storeAudit.title: Paid full-store audit
storeAudit.description: A broader, separately commissioned store review with a detailed action plan, deeper investigation and a walkthrough, as specified in the proposal.

seoAudit.title: Paid SEO audit
seoAudit.description: A search-focused technical and discoverability assessment with documented findings, a baseline and a prioritized SEO roadmap.

scopeComparison.note: Additional research, implementation and any access to private business data require an agreed scope.
